description: This Java class 'CommandHandlerWrapper' encapsulates a command handler for use in a command consumer, managing device and gateway identifiers, and handling remote closure events.

classes.name: CommandHandlerWrapper
classes.description: A final class that wraps command handling logic, associating device and gateway IDs with command and remote close handlers.

methods.name: CommandHandlerWrapper
methods.description: Constructor initializing device ID, optional gateway ID, command handler, and optional remote close handler.

methods.name: getGatewayId
methods.description: Returns the gateway identifier or null.

methods.name: handleCommand
methods.description: Invokes the command handler with the provided command context.

methods.name: handleRemoteClose
methods.description: Invokes the remote close handler if it exists.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the CommandHandlerWrapper instance.
